headline: President Obama created an advisory council to focus on helping young Americans build money management skills.
what_it_does: This executive order set up the President's Advisory Council on Financial Capability for Young Americans. Based on the title, the council's job was to advise the President on ways to help young people understand and manage money. No summary was provided, so details such as who served on the council and how long it lasted are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: They were the focus of the council's advice on improving financial knowledge and skills.
